sources.title: Flinders River Flood Warning System
sources.date_basis: Visible Last updated statement in the acquired page.
sources.source_role: Official English hydrological usage and regional course description.
sources.direct_quote: The Cloncurry and Corella Rivers, its major tributaries, enter the river from the southwest above Canobie.
own_factual_extraction: BOM describes a northwest Queensland river rising northeast of Hughenden, going west toward Julia Creek, then north beyond Canobie.
Its delta reaches the Gulf of Carpentaria west of Karumba.
The southwest tributaries have their own names; catchment membership does not make every branch Flinders River.
limits: Regional hydrology description; no legal naming register or surveyed mouth coordinate.

sources.title: Coastal Rivers - North: Flinders, Morning Basins, Flood Warning Network
sources.agency_or_publisher: Australian Government, Bureau of Meteorology, Flood Forecasting and Warning Services, Brisbane
sources.date_basis: Map title says Flood Warning Network, as at 30/10/2020. HTTP Last-Modified is 2020-12-04 and is not the mapped network date.
sources.source_role: Complete original regional basin map, including separately named major rivers.
sources.map_coverage: Full Flinders and Morning basins, headwaters east of Hughenden, western tributaries and Gulf coast, with adjoining Norman and Leichhardt drainage context.
own_factual_extraction: The labeled east-to-west Flinders course passes Hughenden and Richmond before turning northwest and north.
Cloncurry and Corella are separately labeled southwest courses; Saxby is a separate eastern branch north of the main east-west Flinders course.
The northern lowland map also distinguishes Bynoe River and Armstrong Creek near the coastal outlet area.
limits: Flood-warning network map uses generalized river linework and is not a complete per-reach naming gazetteer.
No surveyed outlet or certified coastline is established by this map.

sources.title: Basin map for Flinders
sources.visible_map_title: Flood Warning Network / Settlement Risk / Flinders Basin / Appendix I. Rev. 0.
sources.agency_or_publisher: State of Queensland, Department of Natural Resources and Mines; prepared by Kellogg Brown & Root Pty Ltd (KBR); official Queensland disaster website host
sources.date_basis: No explicit map issue date established. PDF metadata records creation 2015-11-02 and modification 2017-05-22; neither is asserted as a formal publication date.
sources.source_role: Distinct complete official regional basin/cartographic original; finer local river-name distinctions.
sources.map_coverage: Whole Flinders Basin from eastern and southern headwaters to the Gulf, including all geographic regions containing the five baseline fragments.
own_factual_extraction: Flinders River labels recur along the Hughenden-Richmond corridor, the northwest bend and the lower northward course.
The western network separately labels Cloncurry, Corella and Dugald rivers, as well as smaller adjoining channels.
Saxby River and other eastern branches remain distinct from the principal Flinders course.
Bynoe River and Armstrong Creek are labeled separately in the coastal network.
limits: Regional generalized cartography, not legal boundaries, an exhaustive official reach-name crosswalk or a surveyed coastline.
Named tributaries may join and branch across a complex lowland network; source-derived paths need reach-specific review.
